verdict.rationale: Featurebase exposes a REST API (Posts, Reports, Training Data, Help Center edit endpoints) and webhooks that can be called programmatically from scripts or CI pipelines without using the UI, which supports headless automation. However there is no explicit CI/automation guide, no CLI tool, and the OpenAPI spec probe returned 404s, so machine-readable API discovery for automation tooling is incomplete. missing for 10: explicit CI/headless usage documentation, official CLI, discoverable OpenAPI/swagger spec for programmatic client generation.
